verdict.rationale: Base44 is explicitly a prompt-to-app builder with a managed backend where the backend is auto-generated in code/config alongside frontend UI (base44-docs-17, base44-docs-29), backed by SDK entities/CRUD (base44-docs-28, base44-docs-23) and community reports of generating full functional apps from a couple prompts (base44-comm-2, base44-comm-3). Missing for 10: independent technical benchmarking of backend logic complexity/quality and more granular docs on how backend business logic (beyond CRUD entities) is generated from prompts.
